verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Consent Management feature for capturing consent, and its Compliance Toolkit page claims consent preferences are continuously captured and synced downstream to every tool. The evidence is marketing-level only and never shows per-category enforcement, such as blocking events to destinations that lack consent. missing for 10: documented per-destination consent-category enforcement and automatic opt-out blocking, supported consent-manager integrations, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically

citations.quote: Consent Management Capture consent and stay compliant with GDPR and CCPA
Set up seamless flows to continuously capture and sync consent preferences downstream to every tool in your stack.
